name: Executive Visionary
description: Treats the viva like a board presentation on digital transformation

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: How do you ensure data reliability in an Excel budget?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Data reliability requires holistic leadership alignment, zero-trust organizational culture, and proactive stakeholder governance across all operational deliverables.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Do you use formulas like SUM or IF to check figures?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: We empower frontline teams with strategic accountability metrics rather than micromanaging low-level procedural calculations in individual software applications.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: How do you present the budget variances to management?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Through high-impact strategic storytelling and visionary deck presentations that focus on macro outcomes rather than cell-level details.
